about.title: Designed for the way you live.
about.paragraph_1: At Intra Aura, we believe furniture should be more than functional. Every piece should bring comfort, character and a sense of identity to your space.
about.paragraph_2: From carefully selected materials to timeless designs, we create pieces made for modern living.

services.title: Crafted for your space.
services.description: From individual pieces to complete interiors, we help create spaces that feel distinctly yours.

cta.description: Tell us what you're looking for. Let's create something beautiful for your space.

hero.description: We believe the furniture around us should do more than fill a room. It should create comfort, character and a feeling of belonging.

story.paragraph_1: At Intra Aura, we approach furniture with a simple belief: good design should feel effortless.
story.paragraph_2: We bring together considered forms, quality materials and timeless aesthetics to create pieces that naturally belong in your home.
story.paragraph_3: Every detail is chosen with purpose — from the proportions of a piece to the materials and finishes that give it character.

items: Every form, proportion and detail is considered to create furniture that feels both beautiful and purposeful.
We create pieces designed to remain relevant beyond passing trends and changing seasons.
Materials and finishes are carefully selected for their character, durability and feel.
Beautiful furniture should still be comfortable, practical and made for everyday life.

hero.description: From bespoke furniture to complete interior solutions, we bring thoughtful design and refined craftsmanship into every space.

intro.description: Every space has its own character. Our services are created to help you bring that character to life through considered furniture and interiors.

items: Bespoke furniture designed around your space, dimensions and personal style.
Thoughtfully curated furniture and details that create a refined and cohesive interior.
Practical layouts that balance movement, comfort and visual harmony.
Guidance on materials, proportions, finishes and pieces suited to your space.
Personalised materials, colours and finishes for a distinctive result.
From selecting individual pieces to creating a complete, harmonious space.

intro.description: From intimate living spaces to statement furniture, every project begins with an understanding of the people and spaces it is designed for.
